repository_entries.description: Pin installation to v1.3.0 and record published security, Preview availability and public consumer acceptance.

Upgrade recommended: update all Powertools modules used by your application to this release, rebuild with Go 1.27.3 or newer, and redeploy your Lambda binaries to pick up refreshed Go dependencies. This release also remediates five Zod/fast-uri advisories in repository development tooling and introduces no public Go API changes.
Patch Zod and fast-uri vulnerabilities in reference tooling and report the installed Zod version.
Run Linux test containers with UTC and record scoped dependency security acceptance.
